name: Degrees
overview: The Bible passage in 2 Kings 20:9-11 recounts a miraculous sign given to King Hezekiah involving the shadow on the dial of Ahaz. Isaiah offers Hezekiah a choice for the shadow to move forward or backward ten degrees, symbolizing God's power over time and natural order. Hezekiah requests the shadow to return backward, and God answers by causing the shadow to move ten degrees backward, confirming His sovereign intervention and faithfulness to His promises.
